  Roll call was requested by Turek of Pottawattamie and B. Meyer of
Polk.

722                            JOURNAL OF THE HOUSE                  71st Day



   Absent or not voting, 10:

   The motion to suspend the rules lost.

   Scholten of Woodbury offered amendment H–8249 filed by the
representative.

  Wills of Dickinson rose on a point of order that amendment H–8249
was not germane.

   The Speaker ruled the point well taken and amendment H–8249 not
germane.

   Scholten of Woodbury asked for unanimous consent to suspend the
rules to consider amendment H–8249.

   Objection was raised.

  Scholten of Woodbury moved to suspend the rules to consider
amendment H–8249.

  Roll call was requested by Scholten of Woodbury and B. Meyer of
Polk.
